findings.motion: SB 1174 Senate Third Reading, Assembly floor
findings.note: Voted aye on the Assembly floor (57 to 16) for SB 1174, which bars local voter-identification requirements. Source is the Internet Archive copy of the leginfo vote page.

findings.motion: Assembly Elections Committee: do pass and re-refer to Local Government
findings.note: Voted aye in the Assembly Elections Committee (6 to 2) on SB 1174, which bars local voter-identification requirements. Source is the Internet Archive copy of the leginfo vote page.

findings.motion: Assembly Elections Committee: do pass and re-refer to Judiciary
findings.note: Voted no in the Assembly Elections Committee (2 to 5) on AB 25, the California Voter ID and Election Integrity Act of 2025; the motion failed. Source is the Internet Archive copy of the leginfo vote page.

findings.motion: Assembly Elections Committee: reconsideration of AB 25
findings.note: Voted no on the motion to reconsider AB 25 in the same committee (2 to 5). Source is the Internet Archive copy of the leginfo vote page.

Voted aye on the Assembly floor (60 to 18) for AB 1116, which lets a person register online without a driver's license or state ID by giving the last four digits of a Social Security number, with the state checking name, birth date and those digits. Source is the Internet Archive copy of the leginfo vote page.

findings.motion: Assembly Elections Committee: do pass as amended and re-refer to Appropriations
findings.note: Voted aye in the Assembly Elections Committee (5 to 2) on AB 1116, which lets a person register online without a driver's license or state ID by giving the last four digits of a Social Security number. Source is the Internet Archive copy of the leginfo vote page.

findings.motion: AB 1116 Concurrence in Senate Amendments, Assembly floor
findings.note: Voted aye on the Assembly floor (59 to 19) on concurring in the Senate amendments to AB 1116 (online voter registration without a driver's license or state ID, identity checked with the last four digits of a Social Security number). The Governor vetoed the bill on 2026-09-27 per the same page. Source is CalMatters Digital Democracy.
